author: Madison W
description:
Watch Louder with Crowder every weekday at 11:00 AM Eastern, only on Rumble Premium!

The problem with living in Australia is that you do not have this little thing called “rights.” Subsequently, because the government has mandated compelled speech, lies have become truth. If you dare even mention the old truth, such as men are men, you could end up paying nearly $100,000 out of pocket to make amends for such an act. This is precisely what has happened to one woman in New South Wales.

A woman has lost her appeal after she was ordered to pay $95,000 to two trans-identified males for calling them what they are --
title: Woman Found Guilty Of "Misgendering," Must Pay $95,000 For Calling Two Dudes “Men”
